name: Kidney beans Masala with Millet (Italian Curry)
steps: Read the recipe fully, prep and measure all ingredients (mise en place).
Rinse the millet until water runs clear. Cook according to package or pressure cook (1:2.2 ratio) until tender; fluff and keep warm.
Heat a wide pan on medium; add oil and warm until shimmering.
Add onion (and ginger/garlic, if using); sauté 3–4 minutes until translucent and fragrant.
Stir in ground spices; toast 30–45 seconds to bloom.
Add chopped tomatoes and other vegetables; cook down 4–6 minutes until jammy.
Fold in kidney beans; sauté 2–3 minutes.
Add 1–2 cups water or stock; bring to a simmer and cook 6–10 minutes until flavors meld.
Adjust thickness (simmer to reduce or add water). Finish with acid and herbs; season to taste.
Serve warm. Garnish as desired. Store leftovers airtight (up to 3 days refrigerated).
tips: Taste and adjust salt, acid and heat at the end.
If the pan looks dry, add a splash of water or stock.
Cut vegetables into similar sizes for even cooking.

name: Lentils Fried Rice with Potato (American Rice)
steps: Read the recipe fully, prep and measure all ingredients (mise en place).

Heat a wide pan on medium; add oil and warm until shimmering.
